Name: Automated Sorting System For Multiple Chests
Author: AstralFSK
Description:
[size=3]Tired of opening every chests to spam "Add to existing stacks" ? You’re damn right I am.

After returning from the Skull Cavern for the 100th time, I had had enough, so I took the liberty of making the loot transfer process more bearable, introducing: Automated sorting system.[/size]

[size=6]How does it work ?

[/size][size=5]1. Grouping
[/size][size=3]- By placing a stone sign, all the horizontally right adjacent chests will join that group. In other words, 1 sign = 1 group (See the image(s)).
[/size]
[size=5]2. Auto sorting between a group
[/size][size=3]- Every chests in the same group will act as 1 big chest/inventory. If you add an item into any of them, provided that item has an existing stack somewhere in that group's inventory, it will automatically be added to the chest which contains that stack, otherwise, the item stays in the chest you add to (see video(s)).
- All chests within the same group will be re-sorted when player goes to sleep.

[/size][size=5]3. Improved quick depo
[/size][size=3]- Great, now that we have the auto sorting system, how can we save even more time ?[/size]
[size=3]- In vanilla, when you hold left click, it will transfer the item stacks one by one, and right click will transfer the whole stack.[/size]
[size=3]- Now, by holding alt + right click (Can be configed) and drag your mouse along the item row, all the stacks and items will be transferred continuously [/size](See video(s))[size=3]. If you've played Rust, then you'll notice this is more or less the same inventory depo method.
- You can also do the same when taking items from the chest to quickly grab stacks.[/size]

[size=5]4. Compatibility[/size]
[size=3]- Junimo chest in base game won't work in this system as the game doesn't treat it as a chest.[/size]
[size=3]- This should be compatible with most mods like Automate, Junimatic, ....[/size]
[size=3]- Any mod that adds custom chest, as long as it's a Chest type like in base game, will be supported.[/size]

[size=5]5. FAQ (Will be continuously updated if needed)[/size]
[size=3]- Can this be added mid-save ? - Yes.
[/size]- [size=3]I added the stone sign but the chests aren't sorted ? - See section 2, point 2.
- Can I use only 1 of the features ? - Yes, you can turn off and reconfigure the mod in mod config menu.
- Does it work everwhere ? -No, only on farm(s) and inside farm house(s).[/size]

Downloads.Description:
- Add support for different qualities, now also sort for the same items with different qualities.
- Add support for Shed, Animal Houses and Slime Hut (disable by default)
